as_told.title: Detlev Bronk's alien autopsies after the Aztec and Roswell crashes
as_told.place_text: Aztec, New Mexico; Roswell, New Mexico

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Detlev Bronk, a scientist who later ran the Rockefeller Foundation and was president of Johns Hopkins University, was in charge of so-called alien autopsies in the mid-20th century. In a later episode, citing the Majestic 12 documents, papers said to describe a secret group of twelve top officials handling UFO matters, Michels says the bodies supposedly came from crashes recovered at Aztec and maybe at Roswell. If true, it would mean one of the most respected scientists in America examined non-human bodies in secret.
